name: 服务报价和订单管理 (41Z)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item covers the main process steps of a typical service process. With this scope item you can do the following:

  • Create a service quotation to provide customers with information about prices and delivery conditions before they place an order.
  • Create a service order as a follow-up document of an accepted service quotation or directly.
  • Create follow-up documents from the service order (for example, a service confirmation) to execute the service.
  • Invoice a service to your customer based on a fixed-price or based on time and material.

Other service capabilities enabled by this scope item are:

  • Creating service orders from a service order template.
  • Determine service contracts for your customer based on your service offering.
  • Managing different kinds of service items (for example, service products, service parts, expense, tools).
  • Posting of planned and actual costs and revenues.

Therefore, this scope item covers the service process from creation of a service quotation, creation of service orders in which diverse services and service parts can be planned. Service technicians execute the services and optionally use related service parts. After the service order is confirmed and completed, an invoice is created.

Key Process Flow

  • Create Service Quotation
  • Create Service Order
  • Create Service Confirmation
  • Create Billing Document Request
  • Create Billing Document

Business Benefits

  • Use an end-to-end process for service management, from quotation to order to billing
  • Create service orders from service quotations
  • Flexibly combine service tasks and materials in one service order
  • Conduct automatic contract determination if service contracts are enabled
  • Get full integration in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition procurement and billing
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目涵盖典型服务流程的主要流程步骤。通过此范围项目，您可以执行以下操作：

  • 创建服务报价，以便在客户下订单之前为其提供有关价格和交货条件的信息。
  • 创建服务订单作为已接受服务报价的后续凭证，或直接创建。
  • 从服务订单（例如，服务确认）创建后续凭证以执行服务。
  • 根据固定价格或时间和物料向客户开具服务发票。

此范围项目启用的其他服务功能包括：

  • 根据服务订单模板创建服务订单。
  • 根据服务产品确定客户的服务合同。
  • 管理不同类型的服务项目（例如，服务产品、服务部件、费用、工具）。
  • 过账计划和实际成本和收入。

因此，此范围项目涵盖从创建服务报价、创建服务订单（可在其中计划各种服务和服务备件）的服务流程。服务技术人员执行服务并选择性使用相关服务备件。确认并完成服务订单后，创建发票。

关键流程流

  • 创建服务报价
  • 创建服务订单
  • 创建服务确认
  • 创建开票凭证请求
  • 创建开票凭证

业务优势

  • 使用端到端的服务管理流程，从报价到订单再到开票
  • 根据服务报价创建服务订单
  • 在一个服务订单中灵活组合服务任务和物料。
  • 如果启用了服务合同，则执行自动合同确定
  • 全面集成 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 采购和计费解决方案
